flags.message: The event declares moment=distribution, but context.cutoff and context.cut_kind are null and snapshot_provenance is as-stored. The October 14 baseline includes an October 1 response request after the September 23 first distribution. I used that supplied request as legitimate forward evidence, retained the frozen state band and distribution_count=1, and did not infer later docket events. This note makes the unbounded baseline visible for moment comparability; no current disposition was encountered.
